title: Linije 1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 9A, 11B, 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 i vanredan prevoz do Ž.stanice Petrovaradin – Izmena trase za vreme održavanja trke „GRAN FONDO NOVI SAD 2026“.

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, 6. i 7. juna privremeno će biti izmenjene trase autobuskih linija broj 1, 3, 4,  6, 8, 9, 9A, 11B, 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 i vanrednog prevoza Železnička stanica Petrovaradin-Centar.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, on June 6 and 7, the routes of bus lines number 1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 9A, 11B, 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 and the emergency transport of the Petrovaradin-Centar train station will be temporarily changed.

sections.text: Izmena će trajati za vreme održavanja biciklističke trke 6. juna od 16:00 časova do 18:00 časova 7. juna.

text_translations.en: The change will last during the bike race on June 6 from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. on June 7.

sections.text: VANREDAN PREVOZ ŽELEZNIČKA STANICA PETROVARADIN – CENTAR

text_translations.en: EMERGENCY TRANSPORT PETROVARADIN RAILWAY STATION - CENTER

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Uspenske ulice skretati desno u Jevrejsku ulicu, levo na Bulevar oslobođenja,  prelaziti preko Mosta slobode, skretati levo u Ulicu Račkog, desno u Preradovićevu ulicu i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom kretanja

text_translations.en: Buses will turn right from Uspenska ulica to Jevrejska ulica, left to Bulevar oslobodenja, cross the Slobode Bridge, turn left to Ulica Rački, right to Preradovićeva ulica and continue along the regular route

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Preradovićeve ulice skretati levo u Ulicu Račkog desno na Mišeluk, prelaziti Mosta slobode, nastavljati Bulevarom osobođenja, skretati desno u Jevrejsku ulicu, pa levo u Uspensku ulicu do svog poslednjeg stajališta.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn left from Preradovićeva Street into Rački Street, right onto Mišeluk, cross the Freedom Bridge, continue along Osobođenja Boulevard, turn right into Jevrejska Street, then left into Uspenska Street to their last stop.

sections.text: LINIJE 1 i 8

text_translations.en: LINES 1 and 8

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Uspenske ulice skretati desno u Jevrejsku ulicu, levo na Bulevar oslobođenja, levo na Bulevar cara Lazara, desno u Fruškogorsku ulicu i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn right from Uspenska Street to Jevrejska Street, left to Liberation Boulevard, left to Tsar Lazar Boulevard, right to Fruškogorska Street and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Fruškogorske ulice skretati levo na kružnom toku na Bulevaru cara Lazara, desno na Bulevar oslobođenja, desno u Jevrejsku ulicu, levo u Uspensku ulicu i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: From Fruškogorska Street, the buses will turn left at the roundabout onto Tsar Lazar Boulevard, right onto Liberation Boulevard, right into Jevrejska Street, left into Uspenska Street and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA.

text_translations.en: EXISTING STOPS OF OTHER LINES WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE.

sections.text: LINIJA 3

text_translations.en: LINE 3

sections.text: Sa Bulevara kralja Petra I autobusi će produžavati pravo, skretati desno u Kisačku ulicu, levo u Temerinsku ulicu, desno u Venizelosovu ulicu, prelaziti drumsko-železnički most, nastavljati pravo Reljkovićevom ulicom, skretati levo u Preradovićevu ulicu i dalje saobraćati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: From Bulevar Kralja Petra I, buses will continue straight, turn right into Kisačka Street, left into Temerinska Street, right into Venizelosova Street, cross the road-railway bridge, continue straight along Reljkovićeva Street, turn left into Preradovićeva Street and continue on the regular route.

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Preradovićeve ulice skretati desno u Reljkovićevu ulicu, prelaziti drumsko-železnički most, nastavljati Venizelosovom ulicom, skretati levo u Ulicu Filipa Višnjića, desno u Ulicu Marka Miljanova, desno u Kosovsku ulicu, levo u Gundulićevu ulicu, levo u Temerinsku ulicu, desno u Kisačku ulicu, levo na Bulevar kralja Petra I i dalje saobraćati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn right from Preradovićeva Street into Reljkovićeva Street, cross the road-railway bridge, continue along Venizelosovo Street, turn left into Filipa Višnjić Street, right into Marko Miljanova Street, right into Kosovska Street, left into Gundulićeva Street, left into Temerinska Street, right into Kisačka Street, left onto Kralja Petra Boulevard, and continue to drive on the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA I PRIVREMENA STAJALIŠTA U RELJKOVIĆEVOJ ULICI ISPRED KBR. 39 I 42A, TE PRERADOVIĆEVOJ NASPRAM KBR. 47.

text_translations.en: EXISTING STOPS OF OTHER LINES AND TEMPORARY STOPS IN RELJKOVIĆEVA STREET IN FRONT OF KBR. 39 AND 42A, TE PRERADOVIĆEVOVA OPPOSITE KBR. 47.

sections.text: LINIJA 4

text_translations.en: LINE 4

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Bulevar oslobođenja/Futoška ulica autobusi će nastavljati pravo  Bulevarom oslobođenja, skretati levo na Bulevar cara Lazara, desno u Fruškogorsku ulicu i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Bulevar oslobodenja/Futoška Street, buses will continue straight along Bulevar Oslobodenja, turn left onto Bulevar Tsara Lazar, right into Fruškogorska Street and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Fruškogorske ulice skretati levo na kružnom toku i ulaziti na Bulevar cara Lazara, skretati desno na Bulevar oslobođenja i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn left at the roundabout from Fruškogorska Street and enter Tsar Lazar Boulevard, turn right onto Liberation Boulevard and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA.

text_translations.en: EXISTING STOPS OF OTHER LINES WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE.

sections.text: LINIJA 6

text_translations.en: LINE 6

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Jevrejske ulice skretati levo u Uspensku ulicu, produžavati pravo Ulicom Jovana Subotića i Temerinskom ulicom, skretati desno u Venizelosovu ulicu, te desno u Ulicu Filipa Fišnjića do svog poslednjeg stajališta.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn left from Jevrejska Street into Uspenska Street, continue straight along Jovana Subotić Street and Temerinska Street, turn right into Venizelosova Street, and right into Filipa Fišnjić Street to their last stop.

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Ulice Filipa Višnjića skretati desno u Ulicu Marka Miljanova, desno u Kosovsku ulicu, levo u Gundulićevu ulicu, levo u Temerinsku ulicu, produžavati pravo u Ulicu Jovana Subotića i Uspensku ulicu, skretati desno u Jevrejsku ulicu i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn right from Filipa Višnjić Street to Marko Miljanova Street, right to Kosovska Street, left to Gundulićeva Street, left to Temerinska Street, continue straight to Jovana Subotić Street and Uspenska Street, turn right to Jevrejska Street and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA.

text_translations.en: EXISTING STOPS OF OTHER LINES WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE.

sections.text: LINIJE 9 I 9A

text_translations.en: LINES 9 AND 9A

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Preradovićeve ulice skretati desno u Reljkovićevu ulicu, produžavati pravo preko drumsko-železničkog mosta u Venizelosovu ulicu, skretati levo u Ulicu Filipa Višnjića, desno u Ulicu Marka Miljanova, desno u Kosovsku ulicu, levo u Gundulićevu ulicu, levo u Temerinsku ulicu, pravo u Ulicu Jovana Subotića i Uspensku ulicu, desno u Jevrejsku ulicu, levo na Bulevar oslobođenja, desno na Bulevar cara Lazara i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn right from Preradovićeva Street into Reljkovićeva Street, continue straight across the road-railway bridge into Venizelosova Street, turn left into Filipa Višnjić Street, right into Marko Miljanova Street, right into Kosovska Street, left into Gundulićeva Street, left into Temerinska Street, straight into Jovana Subotić Street and Uspenska Street, right into Jevrejska Street, left onto Bulevar liberation, right onto Tsar Lazar Boulevard and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE SAMO POSTOJEĆE STAJALIŠTE “USPENSA-ŠAFARIKOVA“ U CENTRU I PRIVREMENA STAJALIŠTA U RELJKOVIĆEVOJ ULICI ISPRED KBR. 39 I 42A, TE PRERADOVIĆEVOJ NASPRAM KBR. 47.

text_translations.en: ONLY THE EXISTING STOP "USPENSA-ŠAFARIKOVA" IN THE CENTER AND A TEMPORARY STOP IN RELJKOVIĆEVA STREET IN FRONT OF KBR. 39 AND 42A, TE PRERADOVIĆEVOVA OPPOSITE KBR. 47.

sections.text: Autobusi će sa Bulevara cara Lazara skretati levo na Bulevar oslobođenja, desno u  Jevrejsku ulicu, levo u Uspensku ulicu, produžavati pravo Ulicom Jovana Subotića i Temerinskom ulicom, skretati desno u Venizelosovu ulicu, prelaziti preko drumsko-železničkog mosta, nastavljati pravo Reljkovićevom ulicom, skretati levo u Preradovićevu ulicu i dalje saobraćati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn left from Tsar Lazar Boulevard onto Liberation Boulevard, right into Jevrejska Street, left into Uspenska Street, continue straight along Jovana Subotić Street and Temerinska Street, turn right into Venizelosova Street, cross the road-railway bridge, continue straight along Reljkovićeva Street, turn left into Preradovićeva Street and continue on the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE SAMO POSTOJEĆA STAJALIŠTA “BULEVAR OSLOBOĐENJA-BULEVAR CARA LAZARA“ I „USPENSKA-POZORIŠNI TRG“, KAO I PRIVREMENA STAJALIŠTA U RELJKOVIĆEVOJ ULICI ISPRED KBR. 39 I 42A, TE PRERADOVIĆEVOJ ULICI NASPRAM KBR. 47.

text_translations.en: ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE, ONLY THE EXISTING STOPS "BULVAR OSLOBOĖENJA-BULVAR CARA LAZARA" AND "USPENSKA-POZORIŠNI TRG" WILL BE USED, AS WELL AS TEMPORARY STOPS IN RELJKOVIĆEVA STREET IN FRONT OF KBR. 39 AND 42A, AND PRERADOVIĆEVOVA STREET OPPOSITE KBR. 47.

sections.text: LINIJA 11B

text_translations.en: LINE 11B

sections.text: U NAVEDENOM PERIODU AUTOBUSI NEĆE SAOBRAĆATI.

text_translations.en: THE BUSES WILL NOT RUN DURING THE MENTIONED PERIOD.

sections.text: LINIJA 12

text_translations.en: LINE 12

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Uspenske ulice skretati desno u Jevrejsku ulicu, levo na Bulevar oslobođenja i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn right from Uspenska ulica to Jevrejska ulica, left to Bulevar oslobodenja and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: Autobusi će na raskrsnici Bulevar oslobođenja/Ulica Maksima Gorkog produžavati pravo Bulevarom oslobođenja, skretati desno u Jevrejsku ulicu, levo u Uspensku ulicu i dalje saobraćati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection Bulevar oslobodenja/Ulica Maksima Gorki, the buses will continue straight along Bulevar oslobodenja, turn right into Jevrejska ulica, left into Uspenska ulica, and continue to travel on the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE SVA REDOVNA STAJALIŠTA.

text_translations.en: ALL REGULAR STOPS WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE.

sections.text: Autobusi će sa Bulevara oslobođenja skretati levo u Jevrejsku ulicu, levo u Uspensku ulicu, produžavati pravo Ulicom Jovana Subotića i Temerinskom ulicom, skretati desno u Venizelosovu ulicu, prelaziti drumsko-železnički most, nastavljati pravo Reljkovićevom ulicom, skretati levo u Preradovićevu ulicu i dalje saobraćati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn left from Liberation Boulevard into Jevrejska Street, left into Uspenska Street, continue straight along Jovana Subotić Street and Temerinska Street, turn right into Venizelosova Street, cross the road-railway bridge, continue straight along Reljkovićeva Street, turn left into Preradovićeva Street and continue on the regular route.

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Preradovićeve ulice skretati desno u Reljkovićevu ulicu, prelaziti drumsko-železnički most, nastavljati Venizelosovom ulicom, skretati desno u Temerinsku ulicu, levo u Partizansku ulicu, levo u Kisačku ulicu, desno na Bulevar Jaše Tomića do svog poslednjeg stajališta.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn right from Preradovićeva Street into Reljkovićeva Street, cross the road-railway bridge, continue along Venizelosovo Street, turn right into Temerinska Street, left into Partizanska Street, left into Kisačka Street, right onto Bulevar Jaše Tomić to their last stop.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA I PRIVREMENA STAJALIŠTA U RELJKOVIĆEVOJ ULICI ISPRED KBR. 39 I 42A, TE PRERADOVIĆEVOJ NASPRAM KBR. 47.

text_translations.en: EXISTING STOPS OF OTHER LINES AND TEMPORARY STOPS IN RELJKOVIĆEVA STREET IN FRONT OF KBR. 39 AND 42A, TE PRERADOVIĆEVOVA OPPOSITE KBR. 47.

sections.text: LINIJA 69

text_translations.en: LINE 69

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Bulevar oslobođenja/Ulica Maksima Gorkog autobusi će produžavati pravo  Bulevarom oslobođenja, prelaziti Most slobode, skretati desno na petlju Mišeluk do sledeće raskrsnice na kojoj će skretati levo na Put doktora Goldmana do kružnog toka, skretati desno u Ulicu Moše Pijade, levo u Ulicu Majora Tepića i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection Bulevar oslobodenja/Ulica Maksima Gorki, buses will continue straight along Bulevar oslobodenja, cross the Bridge of Freedom, turn right at the Mišeluk interchange to the next intersection where they will turn left onto Put doktor Goldman to the roundabout, turn right into Ulica Moše Pijade, left into Ulica Majora Tepića and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Ulica Majora Tepića/Ulica Moše Pijade autobusi će skretati desno do kružnog toka i isključivati se na Put doktora Goldmana, nastavljati petljom Mišeluk, prelaziti Most slobode, produžavati  Bulevarom oslobođenja  do raskrsnice sa Ulicom Maksima Gorkog i dalje saobraćati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Ulica Majora Tepića/Ulica Moše Pijade, buses will turn right to the roundabout and turn off onto Put doktor Goldmana, continue on the Mišeluk interchange, cross the Bridge of Freedom, continue along Boulevard oslobođenja to the intersection with Ulica Maksima Gorki, and continue on the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA.

text_translations.en: EXISTING STOPS OF OTHER LINES WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE.

title_translations.en: Lines 1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 9A, 11B, 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 and emergency transport to Petrovaradin railway station - Change of the route during the "GRAN FONDO NOVI SAD 2026" race.

title: Linije 10, 14, 41, 42, 43 – Privremeno ukidanje stajališta „Rumenački put – Avijatičarska“

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 04. 06. 2026. godine privremeno se ukida stajalište „Rumenački put – Avijatičarska“.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, the stop "Rumenački put - Avijatičarska" will be temporarily abolished from June 4, 2026.

sections.text: Navedeno stajalište linija 10, 14, 41, 42 i 43 neće biti u funkciji do završetka radova na pristupnim putevima za privremenu železničku stanicu.

text_translations.en: The mentioned stop of lines 10, 14, 41, 42 and 43 will not be in operation until the completion of works on the access roads for the temporary railway station.

title_translations.en: Lines 10, 14, 41, 42, 43 - Temporary cancellation of the "Rumenački put - Avijatičarska" stop

sections.text: SMER A Železnička stanica – APTIV FABRIKA

text_translations.en: DIRECTION A Railway station – APTIV FABRIKA

sections.text: Autobusi saobraćaju redovnom trasom do Rumenačke ulice, skreću desno u Partizansku ulicu, levo u Industrijsku ulicu, levo na Put Novosadskog partizanskog odreda,  levo u Privrednikovu ulicu i dalje nastavljaju redovnom trasom do fabrike APTIV.

text_translations.en: Buses travel along the regular route to Rumenačka Street, turn right into Partizanska Street, left into Industrijska Street, left onto the Novi Sad Partisan Squad Road, left into Privrednikova Street and continue along the regular route to the APTIV factory.

sections.text: SMER B APTIV FABRIKA – Železnička stanica

text_translations.en: DIRECTION B APTIV FABRIKA – Railway station

sections.text: Autobusi saobraćaju redovnom trasom od fabrike APTIV, nastavljaju pravo Privrednikovom ulicom do skretanja desno na Put Novosadskog partizanskog odreda, skreću desno u Industrijsku ulicu, desno u Partizansku i produžavaju pravo do Rumenačke ulice i skreću levo na redovnu trasu.

text_translations.en: Buses travel along the regular route from the APTIV factory, continue straight along Privrednikova Street until turning right onto the Novi Sad Partisan Detachment Road, turn right into Industrijska Street, right into Partizanska Street and continue straight to Rumenačka Street and turn left onto the regular route.

title: Linija 43 – Ukida se stara okretnica u Stepanovićevu

sections.text: Nakon izgradnje dva nova stajališta u Ulici Stepe Stepanovića u Stepanovićevu, autobusi na liniji 43 (Novi Sad-Stepanovićevo) od 03. 06. 2026. godine neće koristiti staru okretnicu.

text_translations.en: After the construction of two new stops in Stepe Stepanovića Street in Stepanovićevo, buses on route 43 (Novi Sad-Stepanovićevo) will not use the old turnstile from June 3, 2026.

sections.text: Nova stajališta su izgrađena u blizini stare okretnice (jedno stajalište za smer iz Novog Sada, a drugo za smer iz Stepanovićeva).

text_translations.en: New stops were built near the old turnpike (one stop for the direction from Novi Sad, and the other for the direction from Stepanovićevo).

title_translations.en: Line 43 – The old turnpike in Stepanovićevo is being abolished

title: Linija 14 – Izmena trase na polascima do i od Veternika

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 20. 05. do 20. 06. 2026. godine privremeno će biti izmenjena trasa autobuske linije broj 14 (Centar-Sajlovo-Veternik) na polascima koji saobraćaju do i od Veternika.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from May 20 to June 20, 2026, the route of bus line number 14 (Centar-Sajlovo-Veternik) will be temporarily changed on departures to and from Veternik.

sections.text: Zbog zabrane odvijanja saobraćaja u delu Ulice kralja Petra prvog u Veterniku (od Ulice Vase Eškićevića prema Sajlovu), navedeni polasci SAOBRAĆAĆE SKRAĆENO DO I OD OKRETNICE NA SAJLOVU.

text_translations.en: Due to the prohibition of traffic in the part of Kralja Petar irvo Street in Veternik (from Vasa Eškićević Street towards Sajlovo), the mentioned departures WILL BE REDUCED TRAFFIC TO AND FROM THE ROUNDBACK ON Sajlovo.

title_translations.en: Line 14 - Route change on departures to and from Veternik

title: Linije 6, 11B – Privremena izmena trase na keju (druga faza radova)

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 19. 05. do 15. 08. 2026. godine privremeno će biti izmenjene trase linija broj 6 i 11B zbog druge faze radova na rekonstrukciji poveznog vrelovoda GRS-TO JUG, od Varadinskog mosta do Ulice Marka Miljanova.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from May 19 to August 15, 2026, the routes of lines 6 and 11B will be temporarily changed due to the second phase of works on the reconstruction of the connecting spring pipeline GRS-TO JUG, from Varadinski bridge to Marka Miljanova Street.

sections.text: LINIJA 6

text_translations.en: LINE 6

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Ulice Marka Miljanova ulaziti u kružni tok, saobraćati pravo preko Žeželjevog mosta, skretati desno na Kej skojevaca, zatim desno na Varadinski most, produžavati Bulevarom Mihajla Pupina i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: Buses will enter the roundabout from Marko Miljanova Street, drive straight across the Žeželje Bridge, turn right onto the Skojevac Quay, then right onto the Varadinski Bridge, continue along the Mihajla Pupin Boulevard and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: Redovna trasa.

text_translations.en: Regular route.

sections.text: LINIJA 11 A

text_translations.en: LINE 11 A

sections.text: Autobusi će od Beogradskog keja saobraćati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses will run on a regular route from Belgrade Quay.

sections.text: LINIJA 11 B

text_translations.en: LINE 11 B

sections.text: Autobusi će do Ulice Marka Miljanova saobraćati redovnom trasom, ulaziti u kružni tok, nastavljati pravo preko Žeželjevog mosta, skretati desno na Kej skojevaca, zatim desno na Varadinski most i produžavati pravo Bulevarom Mihajla Pupina, skretati levo u Ulicu Žarka Zrenjanina, zatim pravo Stražilovskom ulicom i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: Buses will travel on the regular route to Marka Miljanova Street, enter the roundabout, continue straight across the Žeželje Bridge, turn right onto the Skojevac Quay, then right onto the Varadinski Bridge and continue straight along Mihajla Pupina Boulevard, turn left onto Žarka Zrenjanina Street, then straight onto Stražilovska Street and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆE STAJALIŠTE „BULEVAR MIHAJLA PUPINA-DUNAVSKI PARK“  NA BULEVARU MIHAJLA PUPINA.

text_translations.en: THE EXISTING STOP "BOULEVARD MIHAJLA PUPINA-DUNAVSKI PARK" ON BOULEVARD MIHAJLA PUPINA WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE.

title_translations.en: Lines 6, 11B – Temporary change of route on the quay (second phase of works)

title: Linije 11A, 11B - Uspostavljen saobraćaj kroz Ulicu Jovana Cvijića

sections.text: Autobusi na linijama 11a i 11b ponovo saobraćaju redovnom trasom kroz Ulicu Jovana Cvijića od 12:00 časova, dana 15. maja.

title: Linija 5 - Privremena izmena trase u Avijatičarskoj ulici od 07.05. do 15.06.2026.

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve (broj:IV-34-2981/2026) određuje se privremena izmena trase autobuske linije broj 5 zbog rekonstrukcije vrelovoda u Avijatičarskoj ulici u Novom Sadu. Izmenjen  režim saobraćanja linije broj 5 važi od 07.05.2026. do 15.06.2026. godine:

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads (number: IV-34-2981/2026), a temporary change of the route of bus line number 5 is determined due to the reconstruction of the hot water pipe in Avijatičarska street in Novi Sad. The modified traffic mode of line number 5 is valid from 05/07/2026. until 15.06.2026. years:

sections.text: SMER SA TEMERINSKOG PUTA:

text_translations.en: DIRECTION FROM THE TEMERIN ROAD:

sections.text: Od raskrsnice ulica Rumenački put i Avijatičarska, autobusi saobraćaju pravo do kružnog toka gde se polukružno okreću i vreme do sledećeg polaska izdržavaju na  stajalištu „Rumenački put-Kružni tok“ (stajalište linija 10,14,14s,15,41,42 i 43).

text_translations.en: From the intersection of Rumenački put and Avijatičarska streets, buses run straight to the roundabout where they turn around and wait until the next departure at the "Rumenački put-Kružni tok" stop (stop of lines 10, 14, 14s, 15, 41, 42 and 43).

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase u smeru sa Temerinskog puta autobusi će, kao svoje poslednje, koristiti redovno stajalište „Rumenački put-Avijatičarska“ (stajalište linija 10,14,14s,15,41,42 i 43)

text_translations.en: On the changed part of the route in the direction from Temerinski road, buses will use the regular stop "Rumenački put-Avijatičarska" as their last stop (stop of lines 10, 14, 14s, 15, 41, 42 and 43).

sections.text: SMER SA AVIJATIČARSKOG NASELJA:

text_translations.en: DIRECTION FROM THE AVIATION SETTLEMENT:

sections.text: Autobusi linije 5 po redu vožnje saobraćaju od stajališta „Rumenački put-Kružni tok“ i kao prvo stajalište sa Avijatičarskog naselja, koriste redovno stajalište „Rumenački put-Avijataičarska“ (stajalište linija 5,10,14,14s,15,41,42 i 43) i dalje nastavljaju da saobraćaju redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: According to the timetable, buses of line 5 operate from the stop "Rumenački put-Kružni tok" and as the first stop from Avijatičarski settlement, they use the regular stop "Rumenački put-Avijataičarska" (stop of lines 5, 10, 14, 14s, 15, 41, 42 and 43) and continue to operate on the regular route.

title_translations.en: Line 5 - Temporary change of route in Avijatičarska street from 07.05. until 15.06.2026.

title: Linije 11A, 11B – Privremena izmena trase u Ulici Maksima Gorkog od 14.04.

title: Linije 6, 11A, 11B – Izmena trase na Beogradskom keju od 06. 04. (1. faza)

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 06. 04. 2026. godine do završetka prve faze radova na rekonstrukciji poveznog vrelovoda GRS-TO JUG od Varadinskog mosta do Ulice Marka Miljanova, privremeno će biti izmenjene trase autobuskih linija broj 6, 11A i 11B.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from April 6, 2026, until the completion of the first phase of works on the reconstruction of the connecting hot water pipeline GRS-TO JUG from Varadinski bridge to Marka Miljanova Street, the routes of bus lines number 6, 11A and 11B will be temporarily changed.

sections.text: Linija 6

text_translations.en: Line 6

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Ulice Filipa Višnjića skretati desno u Ulicu Marka Miljanova, levo u Kosovsku ulicu, levo na Trg republike, nastavljati pravo Ulicom Miloša Bajića, skretati desno na Beogradski kej i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom kretanja. Polasci do „Danubiusa“ neće saobraćati.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn right from Filipa Višnjić Street to Marka Miljanova Street, left to Kosovska Street, left to Trg Republike, continue straight along Miloša Bajić Street, turn right to Beogradski Kej and continue along the regular route. Departures to "Danubius" will not operate.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE PRIVREMENA STAJALIŠTA U KOSOVSKOJ ULICI (NAKON LEVOG SKRETANJA IZ ULICE MARKA MILJANOVA) I ISPRED DOMA VOJSKE NA BEOGRADSKOM KEJU (NAKON DESNOG SKRETANJA IZ ULICE MILOŠA BAJIĆA).

text_translations.en: TEMPORARY STOPS WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE IN KOSOVSKÁ STREET (AFTER THE LEFT TURN FROM MARKO MILJANOVA STREET) AND IN FRONT OF THE ARMY HOME ON BELGRADE QUAY (AFTER THE RIGHT TURN FROM MILOŠA BAJIĆA STREET).

sections.text: Autobusi će saobraćati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses will operate on a regular route.

text_translations.en: Line 11A (Direction Train Station-Hospital-Liman-Train Station)

sections.text: Autobusi će sa Beogradskog keja skretati levo u Ulicu Miloša Bajića, nastavljati pravo Trgom republike, skretati desno u Kosovsku ulicu i dalje saobraćati pravo redovnom trasom do Temerinske ulice gde će skretati levo, zatim desno u Kisačku ulicu, levo na Bulevar kralja Petra I, desno na Bulevar oslobođenja i produžavati do svog poslednjeg stajališta.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn left from Beogradski Quay into Miloša Bajić Street, continue straight along Trg Republike, turn right into Kosovska Street and continue straight along the regular route to Temerinska Street, where they will turn left, then right into Kisačka Street, left onto Kralja Petra I Boulevard, right onto Liberation Boulevard and continue to their last stop.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE SVA REDOVNA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA, KAO I PRIVREMENA STAJALIŠTA U ULICI MILOŠA BAJIĆA (NAKON LEVOG SKRETANJA SA BEOGRADSKOG KEJA) I TEMERINSKOJ ULICI (NAKON LEVOG SKRETANJA IZ GUNDULIĆEVE ULICE).

sections.text: Autobusi će sa Bulevara Jaše Tomića skretati levo u Kisačku ulicu, desno u Partizansku ulicu, desno u Temerinsku ulicu, levo u Gundulićevu ulicu, nastavljati redovnom trasom do raskrsnice Kosovska/Marka Miljanova, produžavati Kosovskom ulicom, skretati levo na Trg republike, nastavljati pravo Ulicom Miloša Bajića, skretati desno na Beogradski kej i dalje saobraćati redovnom trasom kretanja.

title: Red vožnje na vanrednim polascima Železnička stanica Petrovaradin - Centar od 14. 01.

sections.text:
Kao ispomoć redovnim linijama 3, 9, 60, 61, 62 i 63 i dalje su na snazi vanredni, direktni polasci autobusa sa autobuskog stajališta „Petrovaradin/Železnička stanica“ u Preradovićevoj ulici (oba smera). Autobusi iz Petrovaradina do centra saobraćaju do stajališta kod SNP-a, a iz centra do Petrovaradina sa polaznog stajališta linije 12 u Šafarikovoj ulici ().

Duž cele trase vanredni polasci u oba smera saobraćaju direktno, ne koristeći ostala stajališta.

Shodno ugovoru sa „Srbijavozom“, na navedenoj relaciji prevoz je BESPLATAN.

text_translations.en:
In addition to the regular lines 3, 9, 60, 61, 62 and 63, extraordinary, direct bus departures from the "Petrovaradin/Railway Station" bus stop in Preradovićeva Street (both directions) are still in force. Buses from Petrovaradin to the center run to the bus stop near SNP, and from the center to Petrovaradin from the departure stop of line 12 in Šafarikova street ().

Along the entire route, extraordinary departures in both directions operate directly, without using other stops.

According to the contract with "Srbijavoz", transportation on the mentioned route is FREE.

title: Linija 9A privremeno preusmerena do okretnice u Petrovaradinu

sections.text:
Zbog preusmeravanja železničkog saobraćaja na Železničku stanicu Petrovaradin, obaveštavamo putnike da je zbog rasterećenja postojećih linija autobusa, linija 9A u smeru od Alibegovca produžena do petrovaradinske okretnice linija 3 i 9, odakle dalje saobraća redovnom trasom do Novog naselja. 

Podsećamo putnike da je na relaciji Šafarikova ulica - Železnička stanica Petrovaradin uvedena vanredna linija na kojoj je prevoz BESPLATAN, te da su građanima pored gradskih linija za prevoz do Železničke stanice Petrovaradin na raspolaganju i međumesne linije 60, 61, 62 i 63 koje kreću sa Međumesne autobuske stanice.

text_translations.en:
Due to the rerouting of railway traffic to the Petrovaradin Railway Station, we inform passengers that due to the relief of existing bus lines, line 9A in the direction of Alibegovec has been extended to the Petrovaradin turnpike of lines 3 and 9, from where it runs on a regular route to New Settlement. 

We remind passengers that an extraordinary line has been introduced on the route Šafarikova Street - Petrovaradin Railway Station, where transport is FREE, and that in addition to the city lines for transport to the Petrovaradin Railway Station, intercity lines 60, 61, 62 and 63 are available to citizens, which depart from the Intercity Bus Station.

title_translations.en: Line 9A temporarily diverted to the turnpike in Petrovaradin
